issues.legal_issue: A writ petition seeking relief against a final record of rights may be refused where the party has delayed unreasonably in pursuing the available remedy.
A writ petition seeking the same relief as a civil suit withdrawn without liberty to file afresh is barred by constructive res judicata.
A litigant who conceals material facts from the court is not entitled to relief.
Uncommunicated government file notings do not create an enforceable right to allotment of land.
